we are able to predict the 3D shape, 2D bounding box and pose of objects in a single image without using any ground truth information or any LiDAR data.
we can reconstruct 3D meshes of objects in a scene from a single image, without using any 3D supervision.

self supervision can be used to train 3D object detectors from monocular images without the need of any 3D groundtruth labels.
differentiable rendering and self supervised learning can be a powerful tool in 3D scene understanding and that it is a promising direction to pursue.
